items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: No. No, I think I played with Dizzy, but not the rest of them

ctx.x: Yeah, he still sounds beautiful. So did you have occasion to play with any of the bebop musicians, like Dizzy Gillespie or Charlie Parker?
No. No, I think I played with Dizzy, but not the rest of them -- Charlie Parker and Bud Powell and all them, no.
You knew Dizzy Gillespie fairly well, didn't you?
